harness: The capture steps are in docs/certification/h-mcp-defer.md (Captures). A lane-scratch Node script spawned the server over stdio with HOME pointed at a throwaway folder and sent initialize at protocol 2025-06-18, notifications/initialized, then tools/list (twice for everything, to record a no-op refresh). Node v24.21.0 on the linuxlt rig. No account, no model call.

files.everything-tools-list.json: initialize + two identical tools/list replies (16 tools) from server-everything
files.filesystem-tools-list.json: initialize + tools/list reply (14 tools) from server-filesystem

largeCatalogue: The >=55k-token catalogue in test/unit/mcpDefer.test.ts replicates the captured everything tools under server names catalog-00..catalog-31 (512 tools). Every tool shape is byte-identical to the capture; only the server id (and so the fitted function name) differs. This mirrors a person running many servers (Anthropic's 5-server ~55k-token measurement, harness-science 1.4) without inventing a schema.
